# Los Angeles Lakers Season Preview | It's Luka Time

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-08-04, 35:07. https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E

## Summary

Josh Lloyd talks with Andy Kamenetzky of Locked On Lakers about a Lakers roster that has turned over more than half its players. LeBron James has left for the Sixers, and Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves are now the core. Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler are locked in as starters. The last two starting spots will likely go to two of Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia and Sandro Mamukelashvili. Walker Kessler is the player who changes the team's ceiling most: he anchors the defense and should be a good rebounding target in fantasy, but his health is a concern. Andy predicts 50 wins with a top five offense and a middle of the pack defense, but thinks the lack of continuity probably keeps them out of the conference finals.

## Rules and methods

- [32:26](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=1946) With fewer teams tanking, win totals across the league may drop even when team quality stays the same. Do not overreact to records that look worse than last season.
  > "like a 65 win team might be a 57 win team, but the same quality"
- [17:56](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=1076) Fewer teams are expected to tank this season and more teams are built to win, so wins will be harder to get in general.
  > "particularly since there are going to be fewer teams looking to tank, forgetting just the new rules or whatever"
- [11:23](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=683) A starting spot can matter less than minutes. A bench player can play about as many minutes as a nominal starter.
  > "probably plays 27 minutes or so anyway which is close enough to that starters role"
- [34:02](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=2042) On teams with heavy roster turnover, early rotations may not last. Coaches may try a setup for around 15 games and then reverse it, so back-end fantasy guys from these teams are uncertain.
  > "they might try something for 15 games, then JJ Reic has to just completely reverse course"
- [27:20](https://youtu.be/_WjOjp6Qu8E?t=1640) A star point guard who makes centers look good can raise the fantasy value of the center he plays with.
  > "And Luca Donuch has made centers way worse than Walker Kessler look really effing good."
